rules.statement: An assignee of a bond given to secure payments due to an illegal lottery cannot sue on the bond if the original assignment was without the mortgagor's consent.
rules.supporting_quote: "After careful consideration, I think the question must be answered in the negative. In Eaton v. Registrar of Deeds[1 7 S. C. 254.], de Villiers C.J. said :- 'In the case of a mortgage bond, however, the cessionary acquires no greater rights than the cedent, so that if the latter cannot sue on the instrument he cannot, as a general rule, transmit a right to the former to sue thereon.'"
